notes: Large-source unit בַּאֲשֶׁר → *Where* retained: preposition and relative fused into one English word carrying both senses, headed on the relative (rules 30, 23).
Both בֵּין units are single prepositions with a dual object, not the בֵּין X וּבֵין Y pair rule 26 governs, so each simply takes the *At* written for it.
Margin *Or, overpowered* read and set aside (rule 38).
